title: Unparseable date when Nightscout has DE_NORMALIZE_DATES enabled
body:
After setting the `DE_NORMALIZE_DATES` config var for Nightscout to `true` (required for proper data upload from OpenAPS 0.6), xDrip+ is unable to download treatments from Nightscout. The error listed in the "Uploaders" section of the System Status in xDrip+ is
```
Unable to do REST API Download
java.text.ParseException:
Unparseable date: "2019-10-18T20:21:22.781+00:00"
Unparseable date: "2019-10-18T20:21:22.781+00:00"
url: https://....herokuapp.com/api/v1/
```

I can confirm that xDrip+ is able to download the missing treatment info after I set `DE_NORMALIZE_DATES` to `false`.

comments.body: I'm wondering if this is related to #309?

Yes, this is still a current issue. My Nightscout instance I use for xDrip+ previously did not have the config var set. I added `DE_NORMALIZE_DATES` with a value of `true`, and then I took this screenshot.
The reason and possible solutions are documented here: https://stackoverflow.com/a/36798830

@inventor96 What is your time zone and time offset from UTC, -7?

I'm wondering that it differs between your initial comment (offset is +00:00) and your last screenshot (offset is -07:00).

I live in the US Mountain timezone. The fact that the treatment had a timezone other than UTC in the second screenshot could be due to a Nightscout update and/or because I was running OpenAPS 0.7 at that time.

I wouldn't think the timezone difference would be part of the issue, though; the timestamp is still in the same format.
I've fixed this issue and will create a PR soon. The timezone matters during format conversation and if you travel into a different timezone.
@inventor96 Does the latest build fixes the issue for you as well?
It seems to be getting all of the treatments from nightscout, and I haven't seen any errors on the respective status page regarding parsing dates. So it looks like we're good!
